status: ALP reader integration implemented and verified; full goal and release gate remain incomplete
change: The existing hyparquet patch recognizes ALP and exposes generic valueDecoders hooks for V1/V2. All public/legacy/owned fallback routes share parquetValueDecoders. Native numeric decoding and V1/V2 allocation forecasts include ALP output backing plus view charges. Prior patch fixes are preserved; lockfile hash updated.

validation.http: Actual local HTTP server serving the vendored ALP fixture; HTTP 206 and ignored-range 200, four concurrent jobs, 64/128 MiB pools, 8 MiB/query, two-read global concurrency limit, cold/warm shared cache. Every row compared with in-file PLAIN columns, including NaN and negative zero. Cache eviction returns tracked usage to zero. Not a hosted object-store benchmark.
validation.planner: Nullable V1/V2 pages exercise both injected upstream dispatch and native numeric plans. Exact planned bytes succeed; one byte below rejects and releases ownership.

limits: BSON and Brotli decoding remain unresolved release work.
Generic nested ALP fallback uses the decoder hook, but new ALP fixtures specifically cover flat nullable FLOAT/DOUBLE columns.
Tracked allocations exclude BigInt/VM scratch and do not establish a total Worker heap cap.
No throughput speedup is claimed; ALP was previously unsupported.
